title: 12 months of keys
about: Minor scales, blues jamming, writing tracks. About 3 hours a week; a level is about a week. Start scales at 60 and raise the tempo 4 bpm when a pass is clean: the number moves when the playing does, not the calendar.

levels.title: White keys
levels.text: C major and A natural minor, two octaves in eighths: the same fingering twice. Then a song on the white keys, and a solo of your own.

items.title: C major, up and down
items.detail: C major over two octaves, up and back in eighths, right hand. Every note, nothing extra, at 72.

items.title: A natural minor, up and down
items.detail: A B C D E F G over two octaves, up and back in eighths, right hand, C major's fingering from A. Every note, nothing extra, at 72.

items.title: Blue Lantern on the white keys
items.detail: The sax line on the Stage, Medium, every note a white key. An A clears it: 90% or better.

items.title: Improvise on the white keys
items.detail: Your solo over Blue Lantern II's band: two choruses or more, 16 notes, nine in ten on the white keys. Send it; the teacher answers with notes and one idea.

levels.title: Five notes
levels.text: A minor pentatonic, A C D E G, each hand on its own. Then a song on the five notes, and a solo of your own.

items.title: Pentatonic, two octaves, right hand
items.detail: A C D E G up and back in eighths. Every note, nothing extra, at 72.

items.title: Pentatonic, two octaves, left hand
items.detail: The same run an octave down, pinky first. Every note, nothing extra, at 72.

items.title: Maxwell Street on five notes
items.detail: The horn on the Stage, Medium, only A C D E G. An A clears it: 90% or better.

items.title: Improvise on five notes
items.detail: Your solo over Maxwell Street II's band: two choruses or more, 16 notes, nine in ten on A C D E G. Send it; the teacher answers with notes and one idea.

levels.title: The minor blues
levels.text: Am, Dm and Em, then the 12-bar minor blues with the band. Jam with 5 notes only.

items.title: Three chords
items.detail: Am (A C E), Dm (D F A) and Em (E G B), a new one every bar over the drums: every change, all three notes on the 1, nothing extra, at 60.

items.title: The 12-bar minor blues
items.detail: Am, Dm and Em on the 1 with the band, a whole chorus with every change.

items.title: Jam with five notes
items.detail: Three choruses over the minor blues with only A C D E G. Any order, any rhythm.

levels.title: The blues scale
levels.text: Blues scale (add the b5). Call and response: 2 bars play, 2 bars rest. Left hand plays root + 7th.

levels.title: A natural minor
levels.text: A natural minor. See the pentatonic inside it. Land on a chord tone on beat 1.

levels.title: Dorian
levels.text: Dorian (raised 6th) over Am7–Dm7–E7. This is the minor-blues sound.

levels.title: Swing, triplets, space
levels.text: Swing, triplets, space. Steal 3 licks, move them around the scale.

levels.title: Checkpoint: a first 12-bar
levels.text: Checkpoint: record a 3-chorus solo. Write a first 12-bar with a hook.

levels.title: E minor and D minor
levels.text: Same material in E minor and D minor. Transpose by shape.

levels.title: Harmonic minor
levels.text: Harmonic minor: the raised 7th belongs over the V chord (E7), not everywhere.

levels.title: Chord vocabulary
levels.text: Chord vocabulary: 7ths, 9ths, 6ths, sus. Rootless 3-note left-hand voicings.

levels.title: Turnarounds
levels.text: Turnarounds: Bm7b5–E7 back to Am; quick change in bar 2.

levels.title: Major blues
levels.text: Major blues: major pentatonic and mixolydian, mixing major and minor over a dominant chord. G blues.

levels.title: Checkpoint: track 2
levels.text: Checkpoint: track 2, new key, with turnaround. Record it.

levels.title: Transcribe by ear
levels.text: Transcribe 2 short phrases by ear (Otis Spann, Pinetop Perkins, Ray Charles).

levels.title: Motif development
levels.text: Motif development: 3 notes, repeat, vary, answer. Fewer notes, better ones.

levels.title: The left hand
levels.text: Left hand: shuffle, boogie, walking bass. Right hand gets lighter.

levels.title: Modes as colors
levels.text: Modes as colors over a static vamp: Dorian vs Aeolian vs Phrygian, one chord for 5 minutes. The techno-shaped chapter.

levels.title: Beyond 12 bars
levels.text: Beyond 12 bars: 8 and 16-bar forms, Am–F–G, i–bVII–bVI, the Andalusian cadence.

levels.title: Checkpoint: track 3
levels.text: Checkpoint: track 3, not a 12-bar. Minor vamp with a melody.

levels.title: All 12 keys
levels.text: Minor pentatonic and blues scale in all 12 keys. 1 key a day, 2 minutes each.

levels.title: Substitutions
levels.text: Substitutions: tritone sub, diminished passing chords, gospel-blues moves.

levels.title: Altered dominants
levels.text: Altered dominants: b9, #9, 13 on the V. Harmonic minor meets the blues scale.

levels.title: Two-hand independence
levels.text: Two-hand independence: solo while comping. Trade 4s with the track.

levels.title: Form
levels.text: Form: intro, head, solos, ending. Write a full arranged track.

levels.title: Final
levels.text: Final: record a 3-track set in 3 keys and tempos, plus track 4. List next year's gaps.
